description: Reads one app: settings as being edited (draft over the published app), modules, files and storage, today's quota (`capacity.credits`), URLs. `draft` is what waits for neblla_promote; `env.pro.promotedAt` when users last got a change. Read-only. More: neblla_get_llms tools/get_app

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.

env.description: "pro" (the published app, what users have) or "pre" (the private test copy); left out: the environment the developer picked for this app in the panel.

name: neblla_get_app
title: Read an app
